title: A teammate that remembers
blurb: An assistant sits in on a team's planning. Three days later, in a new conversation, it is asked about a billing outage and about who is unavailable, in words it was never told. It finds the memories by meaning, and the people affected by following the graph.

turns.reply: Dana first: she owns the payments service [[owner-dana]]. Then Priya, because the checkout rewrite she leads depends on it [[depends]] [[lead]]. Tomás is on that team too [[tomas-on]], but he is away next week [[tomas-away]].

turns.user: Is anyone unavailable in the coming days?
turns.reply: Tomás. He is away next week, at a conference in Lisbon [[tomas-away]]. He works on the checkout rewrite [[tomas-on]], so Priya, who leads it, may want cover [[lead]].

turns.reply: A thin one, four memories long. Dana owns the payments service [[owner-dana]], which the checkout rewrite depends on [[depends]]. Tomás works on that rewrite [[tomas-on]], and he is at a conference in Lisbon next week [[tomas-away]].
